rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Next.js MCP server enables AI assistants to analyze and understand Next.js applications by extracting API route information, validation schemas, and type definitions. Built by jazelly, it scans project directories to discover route handlers, parameters, status codes and response types, providing structured insights about the application's API surface. Particularly valuable for developers who want AI assistants to help with Next.js API development, documentation, and testing without manually documenting endpoint details.
